name: Greenhollow
description: a cosy hillside village of giant hollowed gourds and pumpkins turned into homes, round wooden doors, crooked stone chimneys, vegetable gardens, lanterns strung along low fences and rolling orchard hills
lighting: warm golden-hour sunlight, soft haze, long gentle shadows
visual_details: giant gourd houses with round doors

name: The Whisperwood
description: an ancient forest of enormous twisted trees with vine-wrapped trunks, bioluminescent blue mushrooms, roots like sleeping serpents and thick drifting fog
lighting: cold moonlight shafts cutting through fog, blue-green palette, glowing mushrooms as practical lights

name: Frostpeel Pass
description: a narrow snowy mountain pass between jagged ice-blue peaks, frozen waterfalls and ancient carved statues half-buried in snow
lighting: harsh cold daylight, blowing snow, pale blue shadows

name: Mount Cinderpith
description: a volcanic wasteland of black glass and ash, rivers of lava, and a jagged tower of charred bramble spiralling into a blood-red sky under falling embers
lighting: infernal orange underlighting from lava, red sky, heavy smoke, hard silhouettes

name: Silverleaf Haven
description: a hidden elven refuge of pale silver-barked trees, cascading waterfalls, lantern-lit wooden bridges and elegant leaf-shaped pavilions
lighting: soft moonlit silver-blue with warm lantern accents and gentle mist

name: The Gloomroot Caves
description: damp twisting caverns beneath the roots of dead trees, dripping stalactites, a black underground pool and heaps of rotten fruit cores
lighting: near darkness, a single cold shaft of light, faint green reflections on wet stone
